rationale: Plant is first-order self-draining heater, tau~150s, positive gain, no deadzone. Near target gain K~0.78 from two settled points (0.25,0.508 in E8 and 0.30,0.547 in E7); low-end secant gain 1.35 from (0,0.17 in E2) to (0.25,0.508). Interpolated hold for 0.5 is 0.244. Use feedforward 0.244 + PI correcting residual. Kp=0.85 gives closed-loop tau~83s for settling <300s without aggressive saturation; Ki=0.009 (Ti~94s) removes offset in ~200s. Tf=14s low-pass + innovation clamp 0.035+0.004*dt rejects single-sample -0.05 to -0.08 negative spikes that cannot be physical (max rate 0.006/s) while adding only 14s lag vs 150s plant. Integral authority +-0.15 covers FF error up to 0.15, far larger than observed 0.05 uncertainty, but clamped to prevent windup; integration frozen when |e|>0.15 and when saturated to avoid cold-start overshoot. Umax=0.65 guarantees equilibrium <0.83 below soft 0.85/hard 0.9; rate limit 0.05/s suppresses chatter without slowing plant.
